conditioningLevel.rationale: low: cleansing-led architecture with little substantive slip - the only conditioning routes are one light cationic polymer (Polyquaternium-7@13, after the sub-1 % Caffeine@9), a late protein (Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein@17) and Panthenol@4; no silicone, lipid, pearlizer or cationic conditioner. Counter-signal: Panthenol is listed early and PQ-7 does add some slip, so moderate is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: low: deposition is light and low-persistence - one light cationic polymer (Polyquaternium-7@13) and a late protein (Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein@17), both after the sub-1 % W-line candidate Caffeine@9, against an effective C1 SLES chassis (reset moderate). No silicone, no payload lipid, no cationic conditioner.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families are present (cationic_polymer and protein_film), so W2 applies; Polyquaternium-7 is substantive to hair.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: The only deposition clues are a single light polymer and a protein, both listed in the sub-1 % zone after Caffeine@9, and an SLES chassis with two buffers removes such light deposits.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would need a plausibly persistent system; W2: the two families present are each late (after the sub-1 % Caffeine@9 and Zinc PCA@15) and light (PQ-7 low-dose, hydrolyzed protein), with no silicone, lipid or quat to make them converge into a noticeable residue.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Two families are present and PQ-7 dose is unknown; a higher PQ-7 level could make moderate the better call.
